Method of Attack: Moves victim's files into a password-protected ZIP archive instead of encrypting them
Demands ransom of ~0.08 bitcoins (~$50 USD) for password to recover files
Distributed through fake profile pages on adult sites with links to supposed password-protected striptease videos
Uses a WinRAR SFX file to extract batch, VBS, and executable files into C:\ProgramData
Displays fake graphic card error to distract victim
Archives files with specific extensions by moving them into password-protected ZIP located at C:\Users.zip
Deletes VBS and batch files after archiving and reboots system
Shows ransom screen demanding bitcoin payment and email contact for password
Includes Restore.exe to decrypt files upon entering correct password
Attack Vector: Fake profile pages on adult websites with links to malicious ZIP files hosted on JottaCloud
User clicks link, downloads ZIP, extracts and runs executable
